'''April 2000 All American Collectibles tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in St. Louis in April 2000. [[Norman Horn]] won it. It is known from Norman Horn's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d591">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-23-here-it-is-another-short-reportd591/ here-it-is-another-short-report], DeckTech (Norman "Norman" Horn, 23 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-23-here-it-is-another-short-reportd591/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' April 2000
* '''Site:''' St. Louis
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Norman Horn]]
